description: Unit test class for the AttendanceDao, testing various methods related to attendance records, reports, and overlaps. Located in the test suite of the orangehrmAttendancePlugin, specifically testing data access layer functionalities.

classes.name: AttendanceDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the AttendanceDao class, contains multiple test methods for attendance record retrieval, overlap checks, and report generation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, sets up the AttendanceDao instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the latest attendance record for a given employee.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance records by their unique ID.

methods.name: testPunchInOverlapRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records and related exception handling.

methods.name: testPunchOutOverlapRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records and related exception handling.

methods.name: testAttendanceSummeryReport
methods.description: Validates attendance report data aggregation and filtering over various date ranges and filters.

methods.name: testAttendanceList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of attendance list over specified date ranges and employee filters.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttendanceSummaryList
methods.description: Tests fetching employee attendance summaries with various filters.
